source_message.text:
1\. Set up Meet Alfred
2\. Set up Zapier account
3\. Integrate Hubspot with Meet Alfred using Zap
4\. Create a Domain and Warm it up
5\. Set up LinkedIn automated Campaign in Meet Alfred
6\. Set up Email automated Campaign in Meet Alfred
7\. Map the data flow from Meet Alfred to Hubspot
8\. Create a Lead Management System in Hubspot
9\. Create different type of reporting

Project Timeline - One week
Milestone - 500 USD

routing_warnings.description: This message requests connecting the email account to MeetAlfred and HubSpot, not configuring an automated email campaign.
The launched campaign follows the new-campaign and Zap workflow; the evidence does not identify it as an email campaign.
This message specifies automation for a prospective outbound campaign without identifying the email channel.
